method: each solid is described by its faces (net), its view from above, its front view standing on the base and (prisms/cylinder) the end view when lying; polygons, prisms (2 n-gons + n rectangles), pyramids (1 n-gon + n triangles) generated from the standard definitions; an option is correct iff the solid / net / view satisfies the stem; squares count as rectangles (a cube is a cuboid)
